title: Digital Agency for Lahore Businesses | 22 Signals
description: A digital agency Lahore companies use for AI, cloud, websites, apps, SEO, ads and video, with one accountable lead and every date agreed in writing.
h1: The digital agency Lahore companies use for tech, marketing and video
intro: 22 Signals is a business solutions company, and we work with established businesses in Lahore. We build the systems a company runs on, from AI and cloud to websites and apps, then grow it with SEO, paid media and video. One accountable lead runs it all, with a written roadmap and agreed dates for each stage.

sections.h: Why Lahore companies look for one team instead of five
p: A typical Lahore business we speak to has a website built by one freelancer, Meta ads run by a second vendor, reels cut by a third person and an IT contractor who looks after email and the accounts software. Nobody owns the result, so when enquiries drop nobody can say whether the site, the ads or the WhatsApp follow-up is the problem.

We replace that with one accountable person, the Signal Lead, and specialist teams behind them. Tech, AI, marketing and video sit in one plan, so the ad, the landing page, the WhatsApp reply and the report are built to work together.

sections.h: The Lahore economy we build for
p: Lahore is the capital of Punjab and one of Pakistan's main commercial cities, and the work we take on reflects the businesses that drive it. A digital agency Lahore businesses hire should start with the sector, not the service.
list: Textile and apparel exporters: buyer-facing websites in English, order and shipment data in one dashboard, and sampling visuals that reach overseas buyers before the fabric does.
Retail and fashion, from bridal couture to pret: Instagram and TikTok content, Meta ads, and online stores that also sell through Daraz.
Salons, beauty and wellness: booking through WhatsApp, local search for areas such as Gulberg and DHA, and before-and-after content handled with consent.
Food and restaurants around MM Alam Road and the city's food streets: menus that Google can read, reels, and ads that drive orders and reservations.
Real estate in DHA, Gulberg, Bahria Town and the new schemes on the edges of the city: 3D renders, lead forms that go straight to sales, and follow-up that does not leak.
Schools, colleges and training institutes: admissions campaigns, parent enquiries on WhatsApp and websites that answer fee and timing questions in Urdu and English.
Clinics and hospitals, including the cluster in Johar Town: patient enquiry handling, local SEO and careful, compliant health content.
Software houses and startups, many of them near Arfa Software Technology Park: cloud set-up, DevOps, AI features and go-to-market for foreign clients.

sections.h: Real work in Lahore: a beauty salon and studio
p: One of the businesses we work with is a Lahore beauty salon and studio. We rebuilt its website, set up local SEO and its Google Business Profile around the treatments people search for in its part of the city, and run its Google Ads with tracking set up to show which searches turn into bookings. We keep the client's name private, as we do for every client, but the work is the kind of joined-up job a Lahore business can expect from us.

sections.h: How we work with Lahore businesses
p: Every Lahore project starts with a 15-minute call to check fit. Discovery follows, and within 5 to 7 days you get a written roadmap: what we will do, in what order, who owns each part and when it lands. You sign that off before build work starts, and our reports measure progress against it.

Your Signal Lead runs a weekly call, keeps a written plan and puts every agreed date in writing. Quick questions go on the channel your team already uses, WhatsApp included. Visits for a shoot or a workshop are arranged when the project needs it, rather than on a fixed schedule.

list: Talk: a 15-minute call to check fit, then a longer session on how the business actually makes money today.
Plan: a written scope with priorities, owners and dates, and cost explained by the factors that drive it.
Build: the site, app, automation, dashboard or campaign, shipped in stages so you see progress every week.
Grow: monthly reporting tied to enquiries, bookings or sales, with the next set of improvements agreed in writing.

sections.h: Pakistani law and platform rules we plan around
p: Data and online conduct in Pakistan sit mainly under the Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act 2016, which covers unauthorised access to systems and data. A Personal Data Protection Bill has been in draft for several years, and we design consent, storage and access as if it already applied, so a Lahore business is not caught out when it passes.

Fintech and payments work has to respect State Bank of Pakistan rules, listed and regulated companies answer to the SECP, and SMS and telecoms sit with the PTA. On top of that, WhatsApp Business and Meta ads have their own policies, and we build within them.

sections.h: Search and messaging in Urdu and English
p: People in Lahore search in English, in Urdu script and in Roman Urdu, often in the same week. A buyer might type "bridal makeup Lahore price" one day and a Roman Urdu phrase the next. We research all three and write pages and ads that match how your customers actually type.
Once someone finds you, the conversation usually moves to WhatsApp. That is why our websites, ads and automations treat WhatsApp as the main sales channel, not an afterthought.

sections.h: Choosing a digital agency: Lahore buyers ask what is different
p: Few firms put AI, cloud and data, marketing, and video, animation and 3D in one team. That matters in Lahore because the jobs overlap: a real estate launch needs renders, ads, a landing page and a lead pipeline at the same time. We have worked with 30+ companies, and the same Signal Lead model runs every one of them.

list: AI consultancy and AI automation, including WhatsApp automation for enquiries and bookings.
Business intelligence and data analytics, from Excel exports to Power BI dashboards.
Cloud consulting for software houses and growing companies.
Web development and app development, including stores, portals and Android-first apps.
SEO and GEO, paid media on Google and Meta, video and animation, and 3D rendering.

faqs.q: What does a first project usually cover?
faqs.a: Usually one clear problem rather than everything at once: a website that does not bring enquiries, an ad account that spends without results, or a manual process that eats staff time. You get one accountable Signal Lead, a weekly call and written dates. Once the first project is live and measured, Lahore clients often add the next service from the same roadmap.

faqs.q: Which industries in Lahore do you work with?
faqs.a: Mostly established companies in textiles and apparel exports, retail and fashion, salons and beauty, food and restaurants, real estate, education, healthcare and software. We start with how your sector wins customers, then choose the services that fit, rather than selling a fixed package.

Your Signal Lead sends a short written update every week: what was done, what is next and anything we need from you. A fuller report follows each month with the numbers that matter for your project, such as enquiries, rankings or ad spend against results. Calls are booked at a regular slot that suits your team, agreed at the start.

faqs.q: Can you work in Urdu as well as English?
faqs.a: Yes for search and ads. We research keywords in English, Urdu script and Roman Urdu, and write ad copy and WhatsApp replies for the language your customers use. Strategy documents and reports are in English unless you ask for something else.

faqs.q: How much does it cost to work with you?
faqs.a: It depends on scope. The main factors are how many services you need, how much content and design is involved, whether you need integrations with payment gateways or accounts software, ad budgets, and how long we run it. We give a written scope after the first proper conversation.

faqs.q: How do you handle data protection for Pakistani businesses?
faqs.a: We design within the Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act 2016 and treat the draft Personal Data Protection Bill as if it were in force: clear consent, minimum data collected, access limited by role and records kept of who can see what. Fintech work also follows State Bank of Pakistan rules.
